title: Complete P0 documentation comprehension review readiness
rawUserRequest: 继续完成文档修改；Agent 先完成并走完 WI，真实使用者在完成后自然阅读，问题作为后续反馈处理，不用 review 挡住执行。

declaredIntent.requestedOutcome: Complete the documentation artifacts and fail-closed comprehension status now, then treat real reader feedback as post-delivery input for later Work Items rather than a prerequisite for execution.

outOfScope: Recruiting, contacting, or identifying participants from repository code.
Adding names, contact details, or other personal identifying information.
Blocking this documentation delivery on reader recruitment or response collection.
Claiming verified comprehension or general-population fluency without evidence.

sources.reason: Raw response shape and anonymization safeguards.

riskAssessment.reason: The documentation can be completed without reader evidence only if its published status remains explicitly unverified and no comprehension claim is made.

reasons: This WI publishes a machine-readable comprehension status and must prevent unsupported claims.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly corrected the flow: Agent completion precedes review, and later reader feedback must not block this documentation WI.

preReviewWarnings: Complete and deliver the documentation with status comprehension_unverified; ingest later reader feedback only through a follow-up Work Item.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record checkpoints before implementation and before completing the documentation lifecycle.

acceptance: The documentation result publishes the exact bound revision, required language routes, minimum future sample, and status comprehension_unverified without claiming reader validation.
The human-readable report explains in plain language that Agent completion is deliverable now and real reader feedback is post-delivery input for later Work Items.
Focused tests enforce the missing-evidence list, sample boundary, and prohibition on comprehension-success claims without participant evidence.
All Contract verification and strict repository lifecycle checks pass before PR, merge, closure, and cleanup.
guidelines: Agent completion and repository verification precede human review feedback.
Keep the exact documentation revision and protocol references visible in the result.
Do not fabricate participant evidence or convert Agent/author answers into reader evidence.
Keep comprehension_unverified until a later evidence Work Item legitimately changes that status.

intent.problem: The documentation work was incorrectly blocked on pre-delivery reader recruitment even though the user expects Agent completion first and natural feedback afterward.
constraints: Do not fabricate or infer participant answers.
Do not claim verified comprehension without reader evidence.
Do not use review as a gate that prevents the Agent from completing the current documentation WI.
Preserve the previous handoff as historical evidence of the corrected process assumption.
intent.rationale: Documentation must be delivered before ordinary users can read it; feedback should drive subsequent improvements rather than prevent the initial documentation lifecycle from closing.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The Agent completes the revision-bound documentation result without reader responses.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The result is explicit, machine-readable, and comprehension_unverified.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: An unsupported comprehension claim is introduced while responses remain absent.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the focused result tests and verify current pending state passes.

scenarioCoverage.reason: This WI delivers documentation before reader feedback; any feedback is a later Work Item input.
evidence: User correction: natural readers review after completion and future issues become follow-up feedback.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Feedback is handled by a later Work Item and does not block this WI.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Confirm the current Contract contains no pre-delivery receipt acceptance requirement.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: No restricted governance paths are changed.

rollbackNote: Revert this study evidence Work Item without deleting archived protocol history.
